blocks.text: Buying a Home in Yarrow, Chilliwack: Local Market & Neighbourhood Guide

parts.t: Yarrow

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Yarrow Central Road, Vedder Mountain Road, No. 3 Road, Kehler Street, and Eckert Street leading to Highway 1 Exit 104. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Yarrow will find detached village houses on deep half-acre to one-acre lots, hobby farms, equestrian properties, and Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) farm parcels surrounding the village core. For a full breakdown of official community plans, catchment maps, and hazard overlays, read our
Yarrow Neighbourhood Guide

Families looking at homes for sale in Yarrow are served by Yarrow Community School (K–5 at 4595 Wilson Road), Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include Yarrow Pioneer Park (2.5 hectares with skate park, playground, and Yarrow Days grounds), Yarrow Community Park (tennis, basketball, Yarrow Library, and Community Hall), and the Vedder River trail network. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Route 55 (Yarrow–Greendale loop connecting Kehler Street and Yarrow Central Road to UFV Chilliwack Campus and Vedder Road Monday through Saturday).

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Yarrow are regulated by the Yarrow Neighbourhood Plan, on-site private septic system and groundwater protection rules (hydrogeological assessment requirements for accessory dwellings), ALR farm bylaws, and Vedder River floodplain levels. What types of homes are for sale in Yarrow?

Which schools serve Yarrow in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Yarrow include Yarrow Community School (K–5 at 4595 Wilson Road), Vedder Middle School, and Sardis Secondary School in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Yarrow?

Residents of Yarrow have access to Yarrow Pioneer Park (2.5 hectares with skate park, playground, and Yarrow Days grounds), Yarrow Community Park (tennis, basketball, Yarrow Library, and Community Hall), and the Vedder River trail network. See our
Yarrow Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Yarrow?

Key road corridors serving Yarrow include Yarrow Central Road, Vedder Mountain Road, No. 3 Road, Kehler Street, and Eckert Street leading to Highway 1 Exit 104. Public transit connections include BC Transit Route 55 (Yarrow–Greendale loop connecting Kehler Street and Yarrow Central Road to UFV Chilliwack Campus and Vedder Road Monday through Saturday).
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Yarrow?

Properties in Yarrow are governed by the Yarrow Neighbourhood Plan, on-site private septic system and groundwater protection rules (hydrogeological assessment requirements for accessory dwellings), ALR farm bylaws, and Vedder River floodplain levels. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Yarrow freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Yarrow are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
